disabled_reason: LOM-P2A-2 Gate 1: J7 pin 6 (AR_RST / PS MIO12) wiring, live pinmux and GPIO ownership not yet verified on the Z2 (Gate 2 hardware step)
hardware_notes: Normally-open button between J7 pin 6 (AR_RST -> PS_MIO12_500, bank 500 3.3 V, R236 10k pull-up) and J7 pin 2/3 (GND), per TUL PYNQ-Z2 schematic R12 p4/p10/p12. AR_RST is also driven low by on-board Q9 (NC7WZ07, open-drain) during PS_SRST_B (SRST1 button); a press on AR_RST cannot reach PS_SRST_B. MIO12 must remain an input.
